How the pieces connect

  1. ag-grid cell edited → cellValueChanged
  2. ProductsService.update() → PATCH /api/products/:id
  3. Express + better-sqlite3 → server/data/lab.db

Postgres would use the same Angular service and REST shape — only the server SQL driver changes. SQLite keeps this lab zero-config.
